notes.title: Winter Update Part 2!
notes.notes:
Welcome to the Winter Update Part 2! Patch notes:

-Now by pressing the “T” button you can take all items from crates etc.
-While in the vehicle, press “C” to put the vehicle back on wheels.
-New look for notifications (UI).
-From now on, the color of an item defines its rarity.
-Vehicles have been improved.
-New look of health, hunger and thirst bar.
-New pause menu.

notes.title: Winter Update Part 1!
notes.notes:
Welcome to the Winter Update Part 1! Here is the list of changes: 

-The map has been covered with snow (except for the desert)
-About 50 gifts have appeared on the map in various locations
-4 new missions
-12 new items
-11 new recipes
-2 new NPCs
-Some new dialogues
-Added ability to dodge under the “ALT” button
-Most melee weapons have their own unique animations
-New location “Desert Fortress” 
-New textures for trees and bushes 
-Bug fixes
-New lobby design

notes.title: September Update!
notes.notes:
-Completely rebuilt map
-added new locations, mostly desert locations
-new lobby design
-new music in the lobby
-new stone destruction sounds
-new sounds of destroying trees
-added effect when destroying trees
-each zombie has its own unique sound
-9 new enemy types
-added 12 new vehicles
-4 new melee weapons
-added machine gun and shotgun
-changed pebble model
-changed stick model to a larger one
-new appearance of trees and rocks
-new sounds and effects of exploding barrels.

The second part of the update will be released later in September.
Note: We recommend deleting the previous game save before starting the game.

notes.title: Big changes at The One
notes.notes: In early September, expect a completely rebuilt map from scratch with new locations, a lot of new vehicles, enemies, weapons, missions and greatly improved optimization.

notes.title: A huge map update!
notes.notes:
More to explore
-The map has been enlarged and the following locations have been added: prison and city (you will find them by going through the tunnel near the survivors' camp)

Map System
-Now finding your way around the game will be much easier with the addition of a map (M button) and a minimap.

More NPC added
-Now, visiting the survivors' camp, you can expect to see more NPC that are not only static, but also walk around the village.

New Lighting
-We have changed the lighting in several locations, including where the game starts, so the game should run smoother.
